purpose: Freeze comparable local fixtures and explicitly preserve cases without a valid legacy baseline.

common.logical_goal: Preserve the same requirement, acceptance criteria, scope, and resulting project artifacts while observing the cost of the local workflow.
invariants: Keep all required criteria, prohibited scope, and uncertainty visible.
Use the same canonical source graph and scenario patch before baseline and optimized runs.
Never treat fixture quality as native-model quality.
Unknown token usage remains unknown; UTF-8 bytes and elapsed time are separate measurements.
Count detail reads, context builds, retries, review, and rework in addition to initial calls.
common.environment_rule: Record Python, platform, SQLite, actual checkout commit, and legacy source fingerprints. Exact condition mismatch means not_comparable.

model_role.role: deterministic local fixture; no provider/API calls

common.quality_rule: Only deterministic source, resource, DB, process, and declared criterion checks can pass here. Native-model semantic quality is not evaluated.

cases.logical_goal: Validate the complete canonical plan graph and render the same full plan artifacts.
acceptance: legacy validator reports valid and complete
Markdown and canonical graph JSON hashes match the frozen output
cases.comparison_rule: Use the exact F0 case and condition fingerprints. A different source, environment, model/role, policy, acceptance, or semantic output is not comparable.
cases.legacy_route: existing phase2 validate_graph + render_docs; frozen F0 measurement is the observed run
optimized_route: F1-F4 typed change and document segments

cases.logical_goal: Change one requirement premise and produce the same complete final graph and plan document while preserving unrelated content.

patch.value: 고정 측정 사례에서 한 요구사항의 전제를 변경한다

acceptance: changed requirement remains linked to its criteria
unrelated graph nodes and relations remain identical
final artifact bytes and hashes are recorded
baseline route performs the existing full validation and render
cases.legacy_route: unchanged phase2 validate_graph + render_docs over the frozen patched graph

cases.logical_goal: Continue the same accepted plan from its pinned source and last accepted state.
acceptance: current source and owner are revalidated
old summary does not become authority
only currently valid evidence is reused
cases.reason: No matching preserved Phase2 resume receipt, pinned run, or prior-session cost trace. A synthetic resume would invent historical behavior.

cases.logical_goal: Give two independent investigations the same authorized requirements and count their follow-up detail reads.
acceptance: each worker receives current required scope
follow-up detail reads and duplicate work are counted
combined result retains source and evidence refs
cases.reason: No preserved Phase2 investigation-context bundle, worker call receipts, or detail-read trace exists.

cases.logical_goal: Keep an unresolved requirement explicit and ask for clarification without guessing.
acceptance: clarification request and follow-up cost are counted
cases.reason: No matching Phase2 clarification exchange or decision receipt is preserved; validator success alone cannot reproduce clarification semantics.

cases.logical_goal: Observe a failed local operation, its authorized retry, review, and resulting rework as separate costs.
acceptance: final source and resource hashes are checked
review and rework are counted separately
cases.reason: No preserved Phase2 retry authorization, review receipt, or rework trace exists. A local synthetic failure would not establish the same legacy behavior.
